common.credentialNote:
## Setup (once)

**1. Get an Apify token** — __link.apifyTokenUrl__

**2. Create the n8n credential**
Credentials → New → **Header Auth**
- Name: `Apify API`
- Header name: `Authorization`
- Header value: `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`

Every HTTP node here points at that credential by name. No token is stored in this file.
common.costNote:
## Cost

Pay-per-event: $0.002 per PDF that returns text (from __link.priceFromPer1k__ per 1,000). Broken links, 404s, and empty PDFs are free. OCR for scanned pages is $0.005 per page.

Current pricing: __link.actorPricingUrl__

t1.name: Extract text from Google Drive PDFs to Google Sheets
t1.sticky:
# Extract Google Drive PDFs to Sheets

Monitors a Google Drive folder for new PDFs, sends them to the Apify PDF Text Extractor, and appends extracted text and metadata to Google Sheets.

## Columns in your sheet
`file_id` · `file_name` · `status` · `pages` · `characters` · `text` · `processed_at`

__i18n.common.credentialNote__

__i18n.common.costNote__

__i18n.common.actorNote__

## Sharing (required)
The Actor downloads each file from its link, so the PDFs must be shared as **Anyone with the link can view**. A private file comes back as a failed row (`not_a_pdf` or `http_403`) and is not charged.

t2.name: Ingest PDFs to Vector Store with RAG chunking and page metadata
t2.sticky:
# Ingest PDFs to Vector Store

Extracts PDFs, splits them into semantic chunks with exact `pageStart` and `pageEnd` metadata, and stores them in Qdrant/Pinecone for RAG retrieval.

__i18n.common.credentialNote__

## Built-in chunking
The Actor chunks text natively when `chunkSize` is passed, preserving page citation boundaries so citations point to the real PDF page.

__i18n.common.costNote__

__i18n.common.actorNote__

t4.name: AI Agent tool: read and search PDF documents
t4.sticky:
# Give an AI Agent the ability to read PDFs

An AI Agent equipped with a tool to read any PDF URL. It can summarize papers, answer questions with exact page numbers, and handle scanned documents.

__i18n.common.credentialNote__

## System prompt guidance
Explains `status`, `ocrPages`, and `budget_incomplete` so the agent understands whether text was truncated or recovered by OCR.

__i18n.common.costNote__

__i18n.common.actorNote__
t4.toolDescription: Extracts full text, metadata, page breakdown, and OCR results from one or more PDF URLs. Always provide an array of URLs in `urls`.
t4.systemPrompt:
You are a research assistant with access to a PDF reading tool. When given a PDF link, use the Read PDF Tool to retrieve its content. Interpret the output fields carefully:
- `status: "ok"`: Text extraction succeeded.
- `status: "no_text"`: The PDF has no digital text layer and OCR is either off or found nothing.
- `status: "failed"`: Download failed, invalid link, or non-PDF file.
- `subStatus: "budget_incomplete"`: The document was exceptionally long or compute budget was exhausted; text is partial up to `pagesExtracted`.
- `pages`: An array of page objects with `pageNumber` and `text`. Always cite specific page numbers when answering questions.
